---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

One sentence describing what you want.

## Problem Statement

What specific problem or limitation does this address? Why does the current behaviour fall short?

## Proposed Solution

How would you implement this? Be as specific as possible.

## Affected Layer

Which architectural layer would this touch?

- [ ] Foundation (config, core, schemas, utils, storage, observability)
- [ ] Ingestion
- [ ] Retrieval
- [ ] Generation / Verification
- [ ] Causal Replay
- [ ] Evaluation
- [ ] API
- [ ] Frontend
- [ ] DevOps / CI

## Backwards Compatibility

Would this change break any existing interfaces, schemas, or test fixtures? If yes, what migration is needed?

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why did you reject them?

## Acceptance Criteria

What does "done" look like? List specific, testable outcomes.
